services.name: New patient exam
services.description: A full exam with X-rays and an oral cancer screening, and a treatment plan if anything is needed. The first visit for every adult patient.

services.name: Checkup and cleaning
services.description: A routine cleaning with the hygienist, polishing and a short exam by a dentist. Recommended every six months; most insurance plans cover two a year.

services.name: Deep cleaning (scaling and root planing)
services.description: Cleaning below the gum line for gum disease, usually done in two visits with local anesthetic. A dentist decides at an exam whether it is needed.

services.name: Tooth-colored filling
services.description: Repairs a cavity with a white composite filling that matches the tooth. Done with local anesthetic in one visit.

services.name: Root canal
services.description: Treats an infected or badly inflamed tooth nerve and saves the tooth. Usually one visit, sometimes two. Most teeth need a crown afterwards.

services.name: Crown
services.description: A porcelain cap for a cracked, weak or root-canal-treated tooth. Two visits about two weeks apart: preparation with a temporary crown, then the permanent one.

services.name: Tooth extraction
services.description: Removes a tooth that can't be saved, with local anesthetic. Impacted wisdom teeth are referred to an oral surgeon.

services.name: In-office whitening
services.description: Professional whitening in one visit, usually several shades lighter. Take-home trays are $250. Needs a checkup in the last six months first.

services.name: Clear aligner consultation
services.description: A free consultation about straightening teeth with clear aligners: a 3D scan, the plan and the cost. Treatment itself is from $3,800, with monthly payments.

services.name: Children's checkup and cleaning
services.description: Cleaning, fluoride and a gentle exam for children up to 14, with Dr. Ramirez. A parent or guardian stays with the child.

services.name: Emergency visit

price.note: for the exam and an X-ray; treatment is extra

services.description: Same-day visit for toothache, a broken or knocked-out tooth, a lost filling or crown, or swelling. We keep time free every weekday for emergencies.

insurance.notes: With other PPO plans we are out of network, but we still file the claim for the patient. We check coverage before treatment if the patient sends their insurance details ahead of the visit.
